title: Introducing Quiz Reports: Track Your Progress with Rapid Recap!
mainText:
We hope this message finds you well. At Rapid Recap, we're dedicated to enhancing your learning experience and helping you stay informed. We’re excited to introduce a new feature designed to give you deeper insights into your performance – Quiz Reports!

What is the Quiz Report?

Every time you complete a quiz on a news article, you will now receive a detailed Quiz Report. This report provides a comprehensive overview of your quiz performance, helping you understand your strengths and areas for improvement.

What’s Included in Your Quiz Report?

  1. Score: See how you have performed in the quiz.
  2. Time Taken: Track the time you took to complete the quiz.
  3. Article Difficulty: Tells you the difficulty level of the article you read.
  4. RQM Score: Review your Rapid Quiz Mastery (RQM) score to gauge your overall knowledge retention.

Additionally, your report will feature a graph titled "Today's RQM Score Update", giving you a visual representation of your progress and performance trends of the particular day.

We believe this feature will significantly enhance your learning experience by providing you with valuable feedback and helping you stay on top of your intellectual growth.

Thank you for being a valued member of the Rapid Recap community. We look forward to bringing you more features that enrich your experience. If you have any questions or feedback, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
